defects.claim: The frame header counts Unicode characters but the decoder requires UTF-8 bytes.
defects.trigger: Frame the supplied two-character Chinese payload and decode it.
defects.impact: The header says 2 for a 6-byte body, so decode_frame rejects the frame.
accepted_descriptions: The frame header counts Unicode characters but the decoder requires UTF-8 bytes.
The header says 2 for a 6-byte body, so decode_frame rejects the frame.
rejected_descriptions: Character count and byte count always differ, even for a fixed ASCII-only producer.

expectation.rationale: The wire-format byte-count contract and actual producer are both in payloads.py. UTF-8 uses three bytes per supplied character.
